mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS skuId, b.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, b.unit AS stockUnit, b.avg_cost AS stockUnitCost, CASE WHEN b.sku_id IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.sale_unit = b.unit THEN 1.0000 ELSE conversion.stock_units_per_sale_unit END AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit, b.version AS balanceVersion, p.loss_rate AS lossRate, p.tax_rate AS taxRate, s.sale_unit AS saleUnit FROM xsy_product_sku s JOIN xsy_product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id AND p.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_inventory_balance b ON b.sku_id = s.id AND b.deleted = FALSE AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion conversion ON conversion.sku_id = b.sku_id AND conversion.sale_unit = s.sale_unit AND conversion.stock_unit = b.unit AND conversion.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.deleted = FALSE AND s.id IN #{skuId}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (poi.sku_id) poi.sku_id AS skuId, poi.purchase_price AS latestPurchasePrice, poi.purchase_unit_snapshot AS purchaseUnit, s.sale_unit AS saleUnit, conversion.stock_units_per_sale_unit AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit FROM xsy_purchase_order_item poi JOIN xsy_purchase_order po ON po.id = poi.purchase_order_id AND po.deleted = FALSE JOIN xsy_product_sku s ON s.id = poi.sku_id AND s.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion conversion ON conversion.sku_id = poi.sku_id AND conversion.sale_unit = s.sale_unit AND conversion.stock_unit = poi.purchase_unit_snapshot AND conversion.deleted = FALSE WHERE poi.deleted = FALSE AND poi.purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND poi.sku_id IN #{skuId} AND po.status IN #{status} ORDER BY poi.sku_id, po.submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST, poi.id DESC
